title: Sportraxs — RMB | UTCT 2026, UT100 official leaderboard
publisher: Sportraxs (official timing platform linked from RMB Ultra-trail Cape Town)
claims: At 10:50 SAST on 22 November 2026 the official Sportraxs UT100 leaderboard listed 447 runners in total: 359 finished, 88 withdrawn and none still on course; the men's field was 366 runners with 295 finished and 71 withdrawn, while the women's field was 81 runners with 64 finished and 17 withdrawn.
The 2026 UT100 men's top three were David Sinclair in 10:01:09, Hannes Namberger in 10:18:04 and Andreas Reiterer in 10:47:26.
The 2026 UT100 women's top three were Abby Hall in 12:14:26, Ekaterina Mityaeva in 12:37:24 and Rebecca Kohne in 12:38:30.
The official Sportraxs leaderboard labels the 2026 UT100 standings 'Official' and reports 447 runners, 359 finished and 88 withdrawn.
Abby Hall's 12:14:26 placed 15th overall on the official leaderboard.

The 06:22 SAST provisional count of 358 finished, 87 withdrawn and 2 on course became 359 finished, 88 withdrawn and 0 on course at 10:50 SAST, an increase of one finisher and one withdrawal; both changes were in the men's field, while the women's field stayed at 64 finished and 17 withdrawn.
